why_layer_16: Chosen on practice only, before the eval test. Per-layer logistic probes (2-fold held-out, x1_probe_quick.py / x1_text_baseline.py): signal weak early (L0 AUROC 0.80, L2 0.93), clear from L13 (0.98); L16 and L31 tie for best (0.985; held-out errors 87 vs 86). Tie broken by stability: the override margin picked on each practice fold was 0.15 / 0.20 for L16 but 0.11 / 0.0 for L31 (L31's gate behaved very differently between halves). L16 also gave the higher held-out practice accuracy (83.6% vs 83.2% suppress-only). Mid-depth is also cheaper: a gate could stop the prefill read-out at layer 16. Layer 31 was not tried on eval.
validated: BFCL single-turn eval halves, live: 80.6% -> 86.5% (p = 7e-15), run 20261106-235745
not_for: multi-turn: AUROC 0.53 on BFCL multi-turn (reads intent, not whether a call is right)
